title: actor.heartbeat — Response
description: Returns the canonical actor envelope after liveness metadata is refreshed server-side for an active agent session. The response remains the canonical actor envelope even though the liveness bookkeeping itself is server-side. This verb MUST NOT mint, rotate, or return credentials, and MUST NOT mutate runtime or parent-linkage metadata.

actor.description: Canonical agent actor envelope for the session whose liveness was refreshed.

kind.description: Heartbeat responses are only defined for agent sessions.

agent_runtime.description: Runtime identifier for the active agent session.

parent_actor_id.description: Human actor responsible for the active agent session.
